headline: Polyplex confirms SEBI-compliant share dematerialization for Q2 FY2026
hook: Routine regulatory compliance filing by Polyplex
summary: Polyplex has announced that it has completed the SEBI-compliant dematerialization of its shares for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. Dematerialization converts physical share certificates into electronic format to facilitate seamless trading on exchanges. This procedural update ensures ongoing regulatory compliance for the company's listed shares. Indian retail investors holding the stock see no direct financial impact from this standard administrative process.
why_it_matters: Purely administrative filing with no financial impact on shareholders.

headline: Polyplex Thailand subsidiary announces capacity expansion
summary: Polyplex Corporation has notified the NSE regarding a planned capacity expansion by its material subsidiary, Polyplex Thailand. The company did not disclose specific financial details or the exact scale of the new production lines in the filing. This expansion is part of the company's strategy to increase its footprint in the packaging film market. Retail investors should note that material subsidiary developments can influence consolidated revenue and long-term growth prospects.
why_it_matters: Potential long-term revenue growth for the parent company
